status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a recorded blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Verification passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Bootstrap owned repository harness
features.user_visible_behavior: Contributors can clone CAI-vLLM, follow one documented startup path, and see truthful task and verification state.
verification: Run bash ./init.sh from the repository root
Confirm exactly one feature is reported as active
Confirm Python syntax, package metadata, and repository hygiene pass
Confirm unavailable GPU dependencies are reported explicitly as SKIP
Confirm README links point to caiqiyue/cai-vllm
features.notes: Covers repository re-initialization, harness scaffolding, package metadata, and README refresh.

features.title: Validate CUDA inference journey
features.user_visible_behavior: A contributor with supported NVIDIA hardware can load Qwen3 and generate text through the documented API.
verification: Install the project on a supported Linux and CUDA environment
Download or provide a Qwen3-compatible checkpoint
Run example.py with CAI_VLLM_REQUIRE_GPU=1 verification enabled
Confirm generated output is returned without runtime errors
Record hardware, dependency versions, command, and output in evidence/
features.notes: Requires CUDA-capable hardware; routine CPU-only startup may explicitly skip this path.

features.title: Reframe repository learning guide
features.user_visible_behavior: Readers see CAI-vLLM as a source-code-first AI Infra inference learning repository and can navigate to its supporting notes.
verification: Confirm README contains no logo image or assets/logo.png reference
Confirm README presents source code before learning notes
Open every local Markdown link in README and confirm its target exists
Confirm docs/README.md labels unwritten topics as pending
features.notes: README is source-code-first; docs/ is reserved for learner-facing AI Infra inference notes.
